title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome
goal: Reproduce the source's selected sensory-to-effector graph finding concerning body-part-specific local influence and its long-range feedback relationships, using the original BANC v888/synapses_v2 graph, source-defined neuron eligibility, body-part groups and influence normalization. Assess improvement of that same finding only under an independently justified scientific comparison. The exact complete numerical result panel remains unselected; detector accuracy is separately named empirical method evidence.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Retained original selected graph-contrast domain: sensory-to-effector organization and local/long-range feedback architecture in the single-female-fly BANC graph, with source node/edge universe, neuron/body-part identities and model-derived influence semantics. This preserves the original scientific question without freezing a new numerical panel, requiring all-pairs influence or claiming whole-paper reproduction. Graph influence is not experimentally measured physiological causation.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: secondary_empirical_method_result: ED2b synaptic-link detection and both-partner assignment on all 16 original expert-reviewed EM cutouts, including pooled TP/FP/FN-derived F1, precision/recall and per-cutout companions. This is a genuine source result and legitimate separately named method task, but cannot discharge graph-finding reproduction or improvement. [coverage: source_documentary_panel_native_verification_unresolved]
prospective_robustness_or_engineering_extension: Degree-preserving nulls, annotation perturbations, edge-threshold sweeps and fidelity-preserving runtime/memory improvements remain separately labeled proposals or engineering comparisons. They are not automatically original-paper controls or scientifically qualified superiority.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

source_roster_estimate_or_statement.estimate: Approximately 363 MB base metadata+edges plus 1.4 GB code/figure archive; high-memory workstation. Whole-network all-pairs influence can require cluster-scale memory/compute; scoped paths/threshold contrasts smaller, estimated.

resources.interpretation: Archive sizes and author runtime reports are source facts where recorded; planning estimates and source allocation bounds are not measured end-to-end costs. No new measurements in this audit.

retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Published F-score, exact source counts and reproduced author detector are distinct. Synapses_v3 is not silently substituted for the original v2 result; neurotransmitter prediction remains a separate source task.
